summary: The prepared source already contains the issue-specific fix from upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32118: Kimi-VL MoonViT uses SGLang VisionAttention with packed sequence metadata instead of the former local SDPA path that materialized a dense mask over all packed image tokens. Added regression coverage for single-image and uneven multi-image boundaries. On the assigned gfx950, the actual Triton packed-attention backend matched independent per-sequence PyTorch SDPA and avoided the removed path's measured quadratic transient allocation.

tests.what_was_measured: Five focused Kimi-VL unit tests passed, including two new boundary subtests proving MoonVitEncoderLayer forwards exact cumulative sequence lengths, max sequence length, and shared VisionAttention metadata for a single image and uneven packed images. The regression fails against the removed implementation because that layer had no VisionAttention module and did not accept forward_metadata.

On one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), SGLang's VisionTritonAttention matched independent per-sequence torch SDPA for lengths [17] and [11,23,7] with max absolute difference 0.0078125 and finite outputs. For packed lengths [1024,1536], current-vs-legacy output max difference was 0.0009765625; the current path had 0 allocator-visible intermediate bytes after output allocation, while the reconstructed removed dense SDPA path peaked at 261237248 extra bytes and its boolean mask alone was 6553600 bytes.

tests.what_was_measured: All applicable repository formatting, lint, safety, spelling, and registered-test validation hooks passed.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-1ddba1aa1093/gpu_probe.log records execution on AMD Instinct MI355X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.
remaining_limitations: The reported moonshotai/Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506 weights and MMMU dataset were not available, so no full-model semantic or benchmark accuracy claim is made.

The reporter used four NVIDIA H100 GPUs with CUDA and concurrency 8; this job had one AMD gfx950 GPU. The GPU probe validates the packed-attention mechanism and gfx950 Triton execution only, not H100 FA3 behavior or a distributed serving workload.

The original 0.4.7.post1 server was not launched. Failing-before evidence is the removed implementation in upstream PR #32118 plus the reconstructed legacy dense-SDPA calculation in the retained probe; the current checkout is already post-fix.
No native library rebuild was needed because no native or production source was changed.
